item.title: Rallying Cry – November 13, 2026
item.description: From Manitoba’s power savings to Nigeria’s Ebola-free milestone, students chatting with astronauts, and a tanker near-miss turned rescue mission in New Orleans, today’s news is packed with hope and progress.
